items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I took my own band up to Toronto with Dick Vance and Jimmy Crawford and Benny Morton

ctx.x: And then I went -- in '68 also I went to Ali Baba for 18 weeks of my own trio, you know, on 59th Street. And I had -- that was nice. I enjoyed that. I had a drummer, what was it? Skippy White on drums and the piano player that was with me for a while, and I had Sonny White playing piano.

And then in '69 I went to Toronto again. That was when I went -- I took my own band up to Toronto with Dick Vance and Jimmy Crawford and Benny Morton, and I think Sonny White went up there with me. And then I went to Africa.
Yeah, now, what was that? What kind of a band did you take there?
